step1_figure.circuit_type: Continuous-Time Resistor-Based Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory
step1_figure.description: Figure 17.21 shows a simplified DSM sensing circuit for resistive memory where the switched-capacitor branch (M1, M2, Ccup) is replaced by a fixed 25k pull-up resistor connected through PMOS switches M3 and M4 to the bit line, controlled by the clocked comparator (Fig. 17.16).

comparator_offset_voltage.description: Built-in input offset voltage of the clocked comparator intentionally introduced by sizing one input NMOS wider

equation.formula: V_OS = V(In+) - V(In-) at switching threshold
equation.explanation: In Figure 17.16, one input transistor is sized wider (13/1 vs 10/1) to introduce an intentional ~50 mV built-in offset so that the bit line is held at VDD/2 + V_OS.
equation.assumptions: Mismatched differential input NMOS pair operated dynamically with clock.

sky130_expected.calculation: With W_ratio = 13/10 = 1.3, Delta_Vth_eff = sqrt(2*Id/(mu*Cox*W/L))*(1 - 1/sqrt(1.3)) ~ 50 mV in typical sub-micron CMOS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for a built-in offset around 50 mV as stated in the textbook text and simulation of Fig 17.17.

bitline_average_voltage.description: DC average voltage maintained on the bit line by the DSM negative feedback loop

equation.explanation: The DSM loop actively servoes the bit line voltage so that on average it equals the comparator threshold, which is VREF (VDD/2) plus the built-in offset Vos.
equation.assumptions: Stable closed-loop sigma-delta operation around equilibrium.

sky130_expected.reasoning: VREF is biased at 500 mV and comparator offset is ~50 mV.

cell_current.description: Average current flowing through the resistive memory cell Rmbit

equation.explanation: The voltage across Rmbit is V_bit - VREF = (VREF + V_OS) - VREF = V_OS, establishing an average sense current through the cell.
equation.assumptions: V_bit average is held at VREF + V_OS.

sky130_expected.calculation: For Rmbit = 50 kOhm: I_mbit = 50 mV / 50 kOhm = 1.0 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Offset is ~50 mV across a 50 kOhm sensed resistance.

bitline_voltage_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple on the bit line during DSM operation

equation.explanation: During clock cycles when feedback switch M3 is turned ON, charge is injected through R2 and M4 onto Cbit, causing a ripple Delta_V_bit on the bit line.
equation.assumptions: Cbit = 500 fF, R2 = 25 kOhm, pulse duration t_pulse ~ 5 ns.

sky130_expected.calculation: During pulse, injection current I_pullup ~ (VDD - (VREF + |Vthp|)) / R2 = (1.8 - (0.5 + 0.42)) / 25k = 0.88 V / 25k = 35 uA. Charge per pulse ~ 35 uA * 3 ns ~ 105 fC. Delta_V_bit ~ 105 fC / 500 fF ~ 200 mV; with feedback regulation and Rmbit discharge, observed peak-to-peak ripple is ~50-150 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the transient ripple amplitude shown in Fig 17.22.

average_supply_current.description: Average current pulled from VDD by the DSM sensing circuit

equation.explanation: Current drawn from the 1.8V supply by the pull-up branch and dynamic switching of the comparator and latch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Textbook reports 20 uA for Fig 17.21 at 1V/100MHz. In SKY130 at 1.8V, dynamic current scales with VDD and higher branch voltage: typical average current is 25 uA to 50 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly referenced in Example 17.5 text (page 503) noting ~20 uA for the simplified topology.

average_power.description: Total average power dissipation of the sensing circuit

equation.explanation: Static and dynamic power consumption of the continuous-time DSM circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Product of 1.8V supply and average supply current.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for Figure 17.21 continuous-time resistor-based DSM sensing circuit clocked at 100 MHz for 600 ns, measuring comparator offset, average bitline voltage, cell current, bitline ripple, supply current, and total power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Figure 17.21: Resistor-based DSM Sensing Circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter declarations for transistors
.param L_xm1=0.5u W_xm1=1.5u
.param L_xm2=0.5u W_xm2=3.0u
.param L_xm3=0.5u W_xm3=3.0u
.param L_xm4=0.5u W_xm4=3.0u
.param L_xm5=0.5u W_xm5=1.5u
.param L_xm6=0.5u W_xm6=1.5u
.param L_xm7=0.5u W_xm7=3.0u
.param L_xm8=0.5u W_xm8=1.5u
.param L_xm9=0.5u W_xm9=1.5u
.param L_xm10=0.5u W_xm10=2.0u
.param L_xm11=0.5u W_xm11=1.5u
.param L_xm12=0.5u W_xm12=1.5u

* DUT Circuit
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm2 N003 N002 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm4 vbit VREF N003 N003 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
VREF VREF 0 500m
X_U1 vbit VREF N002 Out clock VDD 0 SUB_1
Cbit vbit 0 5e-13
R1 VREF vbit 50000.0
R2 VDD N001 25000.0

* Clock generator: 100 MHz, 50% duty cycle
Vclock clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 4.9n 10n)

.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* Transient Analysis (600 ns as in Baker LTspice)
.tran 0.1n 600n 100n

.control
  run
  * Average bit line voltage in steady-state (100n to 600n)
  meas tran vbit_avg avg v(vbit) from=100n to=600n
  * Offset voltage relative to VREF (500 mV)
  let v_os_val = vbit_avg - 0.5
  print v_os_val
  * Cell current through R1 (50k)
  let i_cell = v_os_val / 50000.0
  print i_cell
  * Bit line ripple
  meas tran vbit_max max v(vbit) from=100n to=600n
  meas tran vbit_min min v(vbit) from=100n to=600n
  let delta_vbit = vbit_max - vbit_min
  print delta_vbit
  * Supply current and power from VDD
  meas tran idd_avg avg i(VDD) from=100n to=600n
  let i_supply_mag = abs(idd_avg)
  let p_avg_val = 1.8 * i_supply_mag
  print i_supply_mag
  print p_avg_val
  quit
.endc
.end
